statement: INSERT INTO workspace.mlpabb04fd5.scoredbfc4ef (request_id, account_id, distance_deg, score) SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id, round(sqrt(power(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + power(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg, round(p.base_score - 0.1 * round(sqrt(power(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + power(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6), 6) AS score FROM (SELECT request_id, account_id, CAST(request_lat AS DOUBLE) AS request_lat, CAST(request_lon AS DOUBLE) AS request_lon FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabb04fd5/staging/requests.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)) r JOIN (SELECT account_id, CAST(home_lat AS DOUBLE) AS home_lat, CAST(home_lon AS DOUBLE) AS home_lon, CAST(base_score AS DOUBLE) AS base_score FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabb04fd5/staging/profiles.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)) p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
